description.value: Superbaba is an award-winning Middle Eastern restaurant located in the Atrium building in downtown Victoria, serving made-from-scratch wraps and bowls with pita baked in-house daily. It is a second outpost of the celebrated Vancouver original, recognized multiple times as Best Casual Restaurant by Vancouver Magazine and featured on Food Network's Big Food Bucket List for its falafel sandwich and eggplant bowl. Dine-in, takeout, and DoorDash delivery are all available.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 12m; rack (23 spaces, covered) at 64m. Total: 27 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Victoria location at 1325 Blanshard St inside the Atrium building, matching the OSM address, and the phone (250) 590-2725 matches OSM. Takeout is explicitly offered on the front page ('dine-in, take-out, or delivery'), and press content confirms the menu includes falafel and eggplant bowl — both vegetarian/vegan items. Bike parking, water refill, and washrooms are not mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all three required criteria remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Superbaba is a legitimate, active business in downtown Victoria that would make a strong cycling food stop, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. On-site verification is needed before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Located inside the Atrium building in downtown Victoria. The restaurant has a strong media profile (Vancouver Magazine, Food Network) and a well-maintained website, suggesting an active and credible operation.
